# cdnpro_shields (Data Source)

Lists the platform's origin shields. Use a shield's `id` in `cdnpro_property.origins[].shield`; its `ipv4`/`ipv6` ranges are what the origin must allow-list. Results are sorted by `id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cdnpro_shields" "all" {}

# Resolve a shield by region into the ID that origins[].shield expects.
locals {
  us_shield_id = [for s in data.cdnpro_shields.all.shields : s.id if s.region == "us"][0]
}

resource "cdnpro_property" "main" {
  # ...
  origins = [
    {
      name    = "primary"
      servers = ["origin.example.com:80,443"]
      shield  = local.us_shield_id
    }
  ]
}

# The shield's egress ranges are what the origin firewall must allow.
output "us_shield_allowlist" {
  value = [for s in data.cdnpro_shields.all.shields : concat(s.ipv4, s.ipv6) if s.region == "us"][0]
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `search` (String) Case-sensitive substring match on id, name, region or IP range.
- `used_in_properties` (Boolean) Only shields that are (true) or are not (false) referenced by deployed properties.

### Read-Only

- `shields` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--shields))

### Nested Schema for `shields`

Read-Only:

- `effective_date` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `ipv4` (List of String)
- `ipv6` (List of String)
- `last_updated` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `region` (String)
- `used_in_properties` (Boolean)
